🚨 62,199 arrests in five years — for things people said online.

A new Big Brother Watch report found at least 62,199 people were arrested for communications offences between 2021 and 2025. That's around 34 every single day. Only 12,292 were convicted — roughly one in five.

📍 And it depends entirely on where you live. Cumbria: 25.69 arrests per 10,000 people. Staffordshire: 0.58. Same law, same country, forty times the risk.

👉 Four out of five people arrested walked out without a conviction — but they keep the arrest record for life.

Britain used to be the country other people pointed to on free speech. 34 arrests a day isn't confidence. It's nerves.
